Subject: Candidate: Morgan Lee — quick debrief + score consolidation

Hi team,

Thanks again for taking the loops for Morgan yesterday. I want to lock the scorecard and surface any blocking notes before I follow up with TalentBridge and the candidate. Short ask: please drop your numeric score (1-5) and 1-2 sentence rationale into the Google sheet below by EOD PDT today so I can build the offer/decline recommendation. If you have strong objections, flag them inline in the "concerns" column.

Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aB2cScoreConsolidation (edit)

I attached an interim workbook where I started merging time-stamped notes — feel free to overwrite the row assigned to you rather than creating duplicates.

If we have >60% scores at 4+ and no major red flags, I'll recommend we move to an offer. If not, we'll reconvene.

Attachments: interim-score-merge-20250516.xlsx (stub)

Thanks,
Marissa

Team —

Thanks for the rapid replies. Two operational asks:
1) Please add 1-2 explicit calibration bullets in the comments column (where you say "tentative" or "concern") so I can include them in the packet to recruiting. Example: "needs stronger evidence of cross-team leadership (examples requested)".
2) If anyone has a hard no, reply-all and say so — I will escalate if we have split opinions.

I also think a 15-minute sync would be helpful before we tell Priya to go to offer. I've proposed slots here: https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/15min. If nobody picks a slot by 10am PDT today I'll default to compiling what we have and recommending next steps.

I've attached a quick compiled-comments.txt with inline excerpts from the interviewers for reference.

Quick decision: after stitching the scores (Mina 4, Aditya 3 tentative, Jonas 4, Laura 4) the median is a 4 and no hard no's were raised. Action items:
- Mina: please add the requested leadership follow-up prompts to the "follow-up" column in the sheet.
- Aditya: if follow-up examples move you to 4, reply to this thread so we have a recorded change.
- Laura: I'll hold a 15-min sync at 11:00am PDT today (I booked the slot) — invite sent.
- Recruiting (Priya): you may tentatively hold a 30-minute slot tomorrow for a short leadership/examples call and hold off sending an offer until after our sync.

I'll send the final recommendation after the 11:00 call. Thanks all for the fast turnaround.
